notes.title: Slight Delay......
notes.content: [p]As we are just ironing out a couple of issues, detailed in the previous update, the official release has had to be delayed slightly. As soon as these issues have been resolved, and the build is approved by Steam's QA team, we will hit the RELEASE NOW button, regardless of the time this approval comes through. ːsteamthumbsupː[/p]

notes.title: Known issues in current version - Aug 28, 2025
